Description: Synthetic identifier assigned to each employee.
Survey administration wave associated with the employee record.
Notes: One employee may appear in both waves

Description: Date on which the survey was launched.
Notes: Same date for all records within a wave

Description: Employee's assigned business unit at survey launch.
Allowed values: Client Operations, Technology and Product, Corporate Services

Description: Employee's assigned department at survey launch.
Allowed values: Customer Support, Implementation, Service Delivery, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Product, Human Resources, Finance, Sales and Marketing

Description: Employee's organizational job level at survey launch.
Allowed values: Entry level, Professional, Senior Professional, Manager, Director and Above

Description: Indicates whether the employee directly manages other employees.
Notes: Do not infer solely from job level

Description: Employee's primary work arrangement at survey launch.
Broad geographic work location assigned to the employee.
Notes: Use broad regions, not exact addresses

Description: Synthetic date on which the employee joined the organization.
Allowed values: Valid date on or before survey date

Description: Number of years between the hire date and survey launch date.
Missing-value rule: Never missing when hire date is available

Description: Grouped employee tenure at survey launch.
Allowed values: Less than 1 year, 1–2 years, 3–5 years, 6–10 years, 11 or more years
Missing-value rule: Never missing when tenure is available

Description: Indicates whether the employee met the eligibility criteria for the survey wave.
Reason an employee was excluded from the eligible survey population.
Allowed values: Inactive before launch, Ineligible temporary worker, Joined after population freeze, Left before invitation, Invalid contact information, Other

Description: Indicates whether the employee received a survey invitation.
Indicates whether the invited employee submitted a survey response.
Date on which the employee submitted the survey.
Allowed values: Valid date during the survey field period
Missing-value rule: Blank or NA when no response was submitted
Notes: Must occur on or after survey launch

Description: Indicates whether the submitted response met the analysis requirements.
Notes: Numerator for the official response rate

Description: Summarizes the employee's final survey participation status.
Allowed values: Not eligible, Not invited, No response, Unusable response, Usable response
Notes: Derived from eligibility and response fields
